title: Claims Dashboard | RDS Flag + CyberSource GREEN | Manual Review Override | Compensation Held |
goal: Per call transcript: "Any claim with an RDS flag alert should be sent to manual review or rejected, regardless of CyberSource's outcome." This TC validates that even when CyberSource returns GREEN, if RDS flags are present (geolocation mismatch + multiple email usage), the case is STILL routed to manual review.

checkpoints.step: Per call transcript: "Any claim with an RDS flag alert should be sent to manual review or rejected, regardless of CyberSource's outcome." This TC validates that even when CyberSource returns GREEN, if RDS flags are present (geolocation mismatch + multiple email usage), the case is STILL routed to manual review.

PNR: TCED20; 1 leg AC (YUL?YYZ); Delay 4 hrs; Code 42; APPR EL-01; CyberSource: GREEN; RDS flags: Geolocation mismatch (claim from Nigeria, flight in Canada) + Same email used on 3 other claims in past 30 days
checkpoints.expected: PNR: TCED20; 1 leg AC (YUL?YYZ); Delay 4 hrs; Code 42; APPR EL-01; CyberSource: GREEN; RDS flags: Geolocation mismatch (claim from Nigeria, flight in Canada) + Same email used on 3 other claims in past 30 days
